messages:
Ada (PM): Quick sync — proposing a staggered deprecation/gracepath for the Model-X family. CS asked for per-tenant migration windows instead of one hard cutoff. Initial idea: soft-pin + cohorted auto-migrate windows (30/60/90 days). Need to agree on launch gates and who owns exceptions. 

Sophia (Eng-ML): Sounds reasonable. We need deterministic benchmark gates to avoid regressions. Proposal: p95 latency delta <= +15ms and top-1 accuracy (tenant eval) drop <= 0.8% for auto-migrate. Also run embedding similarity checks for retrieval workloads.

Mike (SRE): Ops note — we can support a per-tenant 'deprecation_hold' flag and a one-time rollback token. Autoscaling overlap for cohorts will add ~10% infra at peak during migration windows. Canary routing + gradual % ramp required.

Priya (CSE): Customers are asking for at least a 60-day overlap. Also want ability to request an extension per tenant. Sales will push for exceptions for enterprise accounts (esp >$50k ARR).

Tom (Sales): +1 to extension path. If we do hard cutoffs some customers will escalate. Suggest a one-time 30-day paid extension for enterprise customers, documented in comms.

Ada (PM): Good input. Concrete launch criteria I want us to agree on: 
1) Benchmark pass on 90% of active tenants' eval suites. 
2) Canary period with <=10 customer escalations over a 2-week canary. 
3) Observability: per-tenant SLI dashboards and automated alerts. 
4) Rollback path tested end-to-end.

Sophia (Eng-ML): Also add an automated daily regression job: run new model vs pinned model on 100 random tenant prompts. Block rollout if embedding cosine similarity drops > 0.03 OR top-1 accuracy drop > 1.0% for retrieval-heavy tenants. Example check: 
```
# pseudo-check 
for tenant in sample:
  sim = cosine(emb_new, emb_pinned)
  if sim < 0.97: fail
```

Mike (SRE): I'll own infra changes: add per-tenant flag, rollback token, and a routing policy that can route tenant->pinned variant on demand. SLOs we should enforce during canary: p95 latency <= 300ms, error rate <0.5%, cost delta per 1M tokens < $10. Deploy-bot should post canary results.

deploy-bot: canary: start 2024-08-08T14:00Z. 12 tenants, 2% traffic each. Metrics forwarded to #prod-observability.

Priya (CSE): I'll draft the customer comms/template: migration timeline, how to opt-out/extend, and where to raise issues. Will include a link to a support form and the one-time extension flow.

Ada (PM): Action items and owners: 
- Sophia: write benchmark thresholds doc + examples (PR by Fri).
- Mike: RFC for per-tenant flag + rollback token + routing policy (EOD Wed).
- Priya: customer comms draft (first pass Wed).
- Tom: list of VIP accounts who get auto-notify and sales extension rules.
- Ada: coordinate canary schedule and update runbook.

Tom (Sales): I'll tag the VIP list and follow up with legal if we need contract language for extensions.

Sophia (Eng-ML): One more asks — include a short eval pack for customers to run locally (small dataset + scripts). Helps reduce false positive escalation.

Ada (PM): Great, let's reconvene Fri 10:00am PT. If anyone hits blockers earlier, ping in this thread and @Ada. :thumbsup:
